_meta.purpose: static.site with a .disco/tweaks.json carrying a palette tweak and a boolean tweak. Exercises the TweakSpec grounding law (palette + boolean) on the static.site kind, plus the tweak-persistence path.

semantic_metadata.note: data-disco-field/section anchor the elements that tweaks affect, so a TweakField.affects entry can be resolved to a real DOM target.

attributes.source: tweak:brand_palette -> affects this element's CSS custom properties

tweak_metadata.note: Two real TweakField shapes. brand_palette is a palette editor (>=2 affected fields satisfies grounding law); show_testimonials is a boolean (controls_behavior=true satisfies grounding law).

evidence_host_must_observe: .disco/tweaks.json parses and every TweakField satisfies the grounding law (controls behavior OR >=1 affected field; text/color require behavior or >=2 fields)
applied palette values normalize to #rrggbb and appear in computed styles
toggling show_testimonials changes section visibility without console errors

expected_output.artifact: static bundle reflecting persisted tweak values from .disco/tweaks.json

known_invalid_variants.name: ungrounded_color_tweak
known_invalid_variants.mutation: a color-editor tweak declared with affects=[] and controls_behavior=false
known_invalid_variants.expected_failure: TweakSpec grounding law rejects: COLOR must control behavior or affect >=2 fields

known_invalid_variants.name: bad_color_normalization
known_invalid_variants.mutation: brand_palette colors include 'royalblue' (named) instead of hex
known_invalid_variants.expected_failure: TweakField color normalization rejects: colors must normalize to #rrggbb

known_invalid_variants.name: tweaks_json_unparseable
known_invalid_variants.expected_failure: ready_for_static_site_verification rejects: tweak store fails to parse, tweak values cannot be applied
